params.body:
Two points from Ilse's mail of 18 September 2026 ("Volgende puntjes hebben we nog opgemerkt"), recorded as decision `klant:beslissingen#type-blijft-na-chassiscontrole`.

## 1. The chosen type survives the chassis lookup (R S1-2.20)

> "verspringt het type wagen terug naar 'Eigen wagenpark' na het gebruiken van de chassiscontrole [...] konden we geen originele eigenaar aanduiden omdat het 'type' gewijzigd was naar 'Eigen wagenpark'."

Root cause: the type only lived in the sheet. Both the Livewire sheet and the classic one reload the page after the VIN lookup and mount from the draft row, which still had type 0 (the draft is written on "Volgende", the lookup button sits on the first step). On top of that the Livewire sheet posted its type value **as** `for_export` (`#for_export_select` is a mirror of `vehicle_type` there), so a documents-only lookup wrote `for_export` 2.

Fix at the root: the shared lookup modal carries a hidden `vehicle_type` (empty by default; the worklist opens the same modal for another vehicle), the three sheet scripts fill it at the click, and `OwnStockController::createFromVIN` writes `vehicle_type` plus the derived `for_export` to the draft **before** the lookup, ignoring the posted `for_export` when the type is present. A caller without the type leaves the type alone.

## 2. "Enkel overnamedocumenten" is listed under "Mijn aangeboden wagens" (R S1-1.2, R B1-1.14)

> "Bij het opslaan van een wagen met enkel overnamedocumenten komt die in het overzicht eigen wagenpark terecht. Dit zou beter in het overzicht van Mijn aangeboden wagens staan zodat we daar de overeenkomst van overname en aankoopborderel kunnen printen."

"Mijn aangeboden wagens" is the list of `export_vehicles` rows; the own fleet is everything without one. The classic sheet set `for_export` 1 for type 2 and `finalizeCreate` created the bidding row; the Livewire sheet kept type 2 at `for_export` 0, so no row, so own fleet. Decision (Shane): a documents-only vehicle is a takeover, not stock, and follows the bidding rules of the sheet (this also closes the open point of 17 September about which rules type 2 follows).

- `VehicleRequest::forExportFor()` is the one place that says what `for_export` is for a type (1 for type 1 and 2); the sheet, the lookup and both finalize paths use it.
- `VehicleForm::updatedVehicleType` and `mount` read a type 2 as `for_export` 1; `finalizeCreate` enforces it whatever was posted.
- `finalizeEdit` gives a type 2 without a bidding row its row on the next save, without mail (the observer already skips type 2). Documents-only vehicles saved with the Livewire sheet between 15 and 18 September move over the first time someone opens and saves them; a one-off data fix for all of them at once is listed as an open point in the finding.
- The prints (Overeenkomst, Borderel) key on the bidding row, not on a bid, so they work for a vehicle that never gets one.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/VehicleTypeSurvivesLookupTest.php` (8 tests, `@rule S1-1.2`, `S1-2.20`, `B1-1.14`): the lookup writes the type and `for_export`; a bidding vehicle survives the lookup and the mounted sheet has the owner picker on step 2; a lookup without a type leaves the type alone; the modal and all three sheets carry the type; choosing type 2 sets `for_export`; a saved type 2 has its bidding row, is absent from `getOwnStockList` and renders in `/exports` with both prints; a type 2 saved as stock moves over on its next save. Mutation-checked (reverting the controller write or the finalizeEdit row fails the tests).

Also run: `AlpineExpressionTest|HandlerWiringTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesSourcesTest|VinLookupMessageTest|VehicleFormOriginalOwnerTest|BiddingTypeChoiceTest|ExportListPhoneCardTest` and the broader `OwnStock|Vehicle|Export|Bidding|Order|Takeover|Rules|Smoke` filter: green (748 tests). `php bin/rules-sources`: "Geen problemen".

## Docs

- Rule S1-2.20 (new), S1-1.2 and B1-1.14 extended and now `klant`-sourced.
- Decision `docs/bedrijfsregels/bronnen/beslissingen/2026-09-18-type-blijft-na-chassiscontrole.md`.
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-18-type-terug-naar-eigen-wagenpark-na-chassiscontrole.md` (opgelost, with the open data point).

No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Vehicle type survives the chassis lookup; documents-only vehicles land under My offered vehicles
